dct_description_sm: This Voice of the People poll seeks the opinions of Canadians, on predominantly economic, political, and social issues.  The questions ask opinions of corruption in society, incidences of bribery, water channels/sources of drinking water, global economy, and environmental issues, including global warming. There are also questions on other topics of interest such as Canadian democracy, politics, and elections. The respondents were also asked questions so that they could be grouped according to geographic and social variables.    Topics of interest include: global economy; business; global issues; politics; water channels/sources; elections; corruption; global institutions; and the environment.  Basic demographic variables are also included.
dct_title_s: Voice of the People, 1st Edition Survey, 2007, [Canada]
